verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own materials say it supports designing, running and analyzing tests and rollouts. They also document a Feature Flags API that assigns users to experiment variants, and they list an Experiments OpenAPI spec. Nothing in the evidence shows goal-metric configuration or statistical significance on results. missing for 10: documented goal/primary metric setup for experiments, statistical significance or confidence reporting on results, in-depth experiment docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can run A/B experiments with goal metrics and statistical significance reported on the results

citations.quote: designing, running, and analyzing tests and rollouts in the same place you do all your analytics
Use the Feature Flags API to assign your users to variants for experiments, rollout, and releases.
Every Mixpanel API is described by an OpenAPI specification.
